record.question: In MS Excel, the function =IF(AND(A1>50,B1<100), “Pass”,”Fail”) will return “Pass” only if
options: A1 is less than 50 and B1 is greater than 100
A1 is greater than 50 and B1 is less than 100
A1 and B1 are both equal to 100
record.explanation: AND is true only when both logical tests are true; therefore the IF expression returns “Pass” only when both inequalities hold. Verified solution (unofficial); reviewed 26 October 2026. References: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/using-if-with-and-or-and-not-functions-in-excel
